quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics should have kept Jaylen Brown instead of trading for Kristaps Porzingis
quotes.excerpt: Could have had Jaylen Brown and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Don't tip toe around it.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Going forward, will Jayson Tatum ever be as good as Jaylen Brown was last year? If not, then why keep him? Could have had Jaylen Brown and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Don't tip toe around it.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yes, he could be. This is my humble opinion. You keep Jaylen Brown, because we seen what he can get you.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: There was beef though to get rid of Jaylen Brown. Big beef. And you know what you could have gone for Jaylen Brown? If you could have got Giannis Antetokounmpo and him.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: But listen though, respectably, they going to take care of their guys. They took care of Jaylen Brown. They sent Jaylen Brown to a good situation. Sending him to Milwaukee, it's not a good situation at the moment. You know what I'm saying? So they would do the same thing for Jayson Tatum. So if you get Giannis Antetokounmpo, you got to send him, you going to send Jayson Tatum, the guy that's been with your franchise and won you a championship, you're going to send him to Milwaukee? You're not going to do him like that.
